##### Project general facts

Opalz is a contemporary residential development by Danube Properties, located in the prestigious Dubai Science Park. Comprising two architecturally striking towers, the project is designed as a forward-looking urban oasis that combines luxury living with innovative, energy-efficient concepts. With its strategic location offering easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Opalz provides residents with seamless connectivity to key areas of Dubai while maintaining a calm, resort-like atmosphere within a scientifically and innovation-driven district. The development emphasizes modern architecture, green building principles, and a forward-looking lifestyle experience.

The project offers a range of lifestyle amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and contemporary urban comfort. Designed to function as a self-contained community, Opalz features thoughtfully planned leisure and social spaces that support relaxation and active living. Residents benefit from a wide selection of facilities that encourage both physical well-being and community interaction, creating an environment that balances privacy with shared experiences. The overall concept is centered around enhancing quality of life through convenience, sustainability, and modern design.

The interiors feature luxury fit and finish, with stylish contemporary design elements that reflect the project’s premium positioning. Residences are crafted using high-quality materials to ensure comfort and durability, although kitchens and appliances are not specified. The apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents full flexibility to design and personalize their living spaces according to their individual preferences and lifestyle needs.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Science Park is a dedicated hub designed to foster innovation in science, energy, and environmental sectors. Situated in Al Barsha South, this vibrant district supports hundreds of organisations with a modern infrastructure tailored to research and development. From biotechnology and healthcare to renewable energy, Dubai Science Park is a cornerstone of Dubai’s push towards a knowledge-based economy, offering cutting-edge facilities and fostering a collaborative environment for professionals in scientific fields.

The area combines business excellence with residential convenience, providing modern housing options alongside essential amenities such as schools, fitness centers, and medical facilities. Located near Dubai Miracle Garden and with easy access to major highways, Dubai Science Park offers a well-connected and tranquil setting. Its strategic location and thoughtfully planned environment make it ideal for both families and professionals looking to balance work and personal life.

Dubai Science Park places a strong emphasis on sustainability and innovation, aligning with Dubai’s vision of an eco-conscious city. Green spaces, pedestrian-friendly areas, and community-focused amenities enhance the quality of life, while state-of-the-art laboratories and commercial spaces create opportunities for scientific advancement. This unique blend of lifestyle and professional opportunities makes Dubai Science Park a thriving community for forward-thinking individuals and businesses.
